headline: Red week on the stock exchange. Wall Street falls most sharply since the pandemic
summary: US stocks had their weakest week since the coronavirus pandemic, with losses concentrated in semiconductor makers and artificial intelligence-related companies. Investors are reportedly worried that a four-year AI-driven rally is ending.
why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US equities, and semiconductor firms are key suppliers to the AI data-center buildout that has driven much of recent market gains.
why_moved: Reports say investors feared the AI-led rally was ending, and semiconductor and AI-linked shares led the losses during the week.
original_headline: Czerwony tydzień na giełdzie. Wall Street traci najmocniej od pandemii
